data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shri’, meaning ‘king’, ‘ruler’, ‘lord’, ‘goddess of wealth’, ‘noble’, and ‘auspicious’. The name Shar carries the meaning “King, Ruler, Noble” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shar usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
